# Federico Molinari

Federico Molinari is an Argentine artistic gymnast who has been one of the most prominent figures in Argentine gymnastics.

## Career Highlights

- **Olympic Participation**: He represented Argentina at multiple Olympic Games, including Beijing 2008 and London 2012
- **Pan American Games**: He has been a consistent medalist at the Pan American Games, winning medals on various apparatus
- **Specialties**: Known particularly for his work on rings and other apparatus events

## Notable Achievements

- He has won multiple medals at South American Championships
- Competed at several World Championships representing Argentina
- Considered a pioneer in raising the profile of men's artistic gymnastics in Argentina

## Personal

- He is the brother of Lucas Molinari, who is also a gymnast
- Both brothers have represented Argentina internationally

## Legacy

Federico Molinari helped establish Argentina as a more competitive nation in men's artistic gymnastics, particularly in the Latin American context.
